### Lesson

Which lesson contains the citation (for example `robotics-4-4.html`)?

### Reference Number

Which reference number is affected (for example `[3]`)?

### What is Wrong

What is wrong with the source (for example: dead link, or the page says something else)?

### Suggested Replacement Source

If known, provide a working link or replacement source.

### Additional Notes

Any extra details (maintainers will label this issue).
